description: Deterministic mapping of real-world rule types observed in 48CS2R5/48CS4/48CS5 to canonical rule families without substring heuristics.

mappingTable.description: Explicit upper/lower age limits or post-specific bands
Minimum age criterion as of crucial date
Maximum age criterion as of crucial date
Permissible passing/appearing years for qualifying exam
Crucial date by which educational qualification must be acquired
Mandatory academic subjects/disciplines studied in qualifying exam
State of eligibility (e.g. school location vs native residence)
State domicile requirement for regional quotas

failClosedPolicy.unknownRuleTypeHandling: Any ruleType not present in mappingTable is marked isRecognized: false and fails closed to status: UNRESOLVED with isSourceGap: true.
failClosedPolicy.personalizationImpact: Presence of an unrecognized ruleType forces overall eligibilityStatus to NOT_EVALUATED.
failClosedPolicy.substringHeuristicsProhibited: Strict boolean equality check against normalized ruleType enum; zero string.includes() matching.
